requested_appearance_window.basis: Accepted C01-49 President of the USSR holder observations attested 1991-01-22, 1991-08-22 and 1991-10-05, and the accepted C01-41 CPSU General Secretary holder observation attested 1991-08-22 (all with from and until null). The start continues his existing 1990 art (mikhail-gorbachev-cartoon-1990-v1.png, 1990-01-01 to 1991-01-01). The exclusive end is the day after 25 December 1991, the gap ledger's audit boundary for USSR-identity roles ('not an accepted dissolution date'); it is not an accepted term end. He is the USSR card's leader by office_links (since 1985-03-11, registry). The window is an appearance interval, not a tenure, and the claim record marks it as needing Codex agreement.

entries.appearance_window_decision: Approved for this bounded generation only as an artistic interval; does not establish office tenure, registry appointments or year-specific photographic attestation.

source_rights.rights_statement: Retained source statement: CC BY-SA 4.0 with VRT permission ticket #2022050610007575 (category 'Items with VRTS permission confirmed'). The upload revision carried {{cc-by-sa-4.0}}{{PermissionTicket|id=2022050610007575}}; on 2023-10-21 (rev 813789119) the licence section was replaced by the {{Leo Medvedev}} template, and the current extmetadata still states CC BY-SA 4.0. The uploader is not the photographer; the licence rests on the VRT-reviewed grant, and whether Medvedev took the photograph for a press employer is not established (open item). Attribution and share-alike apply. The copied bytes are the original upload, unretouched.
source_rights.age_gap_note: Registry birth date 1931-03-02. The photograph (October 1991, month precision) shows him at 60. It lies inside the requested window, about 9 to 10 months after its start (1991-01-01, age 59) and about 2 to 3 months before its exclusive end (1991-12-26, age 60), so no age adjustment is asked for; the prompt asks for a man of 59 to 60. Declared artistic extensions: the full standing body, hands, trousers and shoes (from a head-and-shoulders photograph) and all colours (the photograph is black and white).
source_rights.limitation: Month-precision date from the archive uploader; licence via a VRT-reviewed grant from the photographer's archive rather than the photographer's own upload; greyscale; head and shoulders only.
source_rights.derivative_license_note: The derivative must retain this share-alike licence and the recorded attribution when registered and distributed.
source_rights.adaptation: Original cartoon generated from a style reference and the credited likeness reference; artistic age, body, clothing and color interpretations as disclosed in the exact prompt. No endorsement implied.

codex_visual_review.scope: Exact style and identity inputs viewed before generation; original output visually inspected for likeness, framing, hands/shoes, single-subject cartoon style and unintended text.
codex_visual_review.observations: Recognizable rounded face, receding gray-white hair and forehead birthmark on the anatomical right/viewer-left extending toward the center; no glasses. Full-color pinstriped charcoal suit and burgundy striped tie, both hands and shoes visible. Source grayscale remains unchanged; skin, clothes and background colors are artistic interpretation.
